data.name: Dhunu
data.gender_notes: Dhunu is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The sound of rain or music, a melody or tune. The name Dhunu carries the meaning “Sound, Melody” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Dhunu usually hope their child will grow to embody sound, melody and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder of the divine melody of the universe
data.etymology: Dhunu belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Sound, Melody.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dhunu total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
